text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- National carrier Nigeria Airways to get new lease of life with fleet boosted to eight aircraft from three and staff cut to no more than 900 from several thousands currently, says aviation minister Air Commodore Ita Udo-Imeh.
- Octogenerian leader of opposition NADECO group Michael Ajasin successfully undergoes heart surgery, his doctors says.

- Congress for National Consensus, one of five political parties registered under transition to democracy programme of military government, raises 63 million naira to campaign for municipal elections scheduled for March.
- Opposition NADECO again denies that it is behind recent bomb blasts in Nigeria and urges police to look elsewhere for the culprits.
- Army provides security at Kaduna refinery in the north in the wake of recent bomb attacks in the country.
